s: Al ezeh mine pat mebarekin, ubo k"g seipim: hebiu lepanayv chatika shel pat upat shelema — mitzva min hammubchar lebarek al hashshelema, apillu hi pat qibbar uqetanna vehachatika pat neqiyya ugedola mehashshelema. Vehu shehakkol min echad, abal im hashshelema misseorim vehachatika mechittim, apillu hi perusa qetanna — hi qodemet lebarek aleha, hoil vehachitta muqdemet bappasuq, beshibat hamminin shennishtabbecha bahem eretz yisrael, vekol hammuqdam bepasuq zeh — muqdam libraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"a. Veap al pi ken, yere shamayim yotze yede shettehen, shemmanniach happerusa betok hashshelema ubotzea mishshettehen yachad, hoil vegam hasseora hi miz' hamminin vehi shelema. Abal im hashshelema hi shel shipon, ap al pi shehu min seorim, kevan shello hizkiro hakkatub beperush kemo chittim — en tzarik lehannicho kelal im happerusa shel chittim:

Vekol zeh kesherotzeh leekol mishshettehen, abal im eno rotzeh leekol ella meachat mehen — yebarek aleha, veen lo lachosh lehashshenit ap al pi shehi muqdemet bappasuq vehi chashuba vachabiba alayv, shemmishshum qedimatah vachashibutah eno mechuyyab leekol mimmenna kelal. Veen tzarik lomar im rotzeh leekol hammuqdemet bappasuq, sheen lo lachosh lashshenit hashshelema, sheeno mechuyyab leekol mimmenna mishshum shelemutah. Vaapillu im rotzeh leekol perusa sheenah miz' hamminim — eno mechuyyab leekol mimmenna mippene shelemutah vachashibutah:

Im yesh leadam b' chatzae lechem veen lo lechem shalem lelechem mishneh beshabbat — yechabberem yachad beetz sheyyesh torat keli alayv, o beshum dabar sheeno muqtzeh, velo yehe chibburam nireh, vedino keshalem leinyan lechem mishneh, kemo sheddino keshalem leinyan erube chatzerot, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shs"v. Abal im yesh lo lechem shalem — en lismok al zeh, ki yesh lomar sheeno nechshab keshalem ella leinyan erube chatzerot bilbad, shello hitzriku bo shalem ella mishshum eba bilbad, shello yabo echad lomar: ani noten shalem veatta noten perusa, ukesheen chibburo nireh — en lachosh lekak, abal leinyan lechem mishneh eno nechshab keshalem al yede chibbur zeh, kemo sheeno nechshab kikkar echad leinyan tuma vetohora al yede chibbur zeh. Ubechol en tzarik lechabbero kelal:

Shette geluseqaot haddebuqot zo bazo, shenneepu venidbequ battannur kak, venechtak min haachat vehashsheniyya nishara shelema — tob yoter lehaprid hachatika mehashshelema kede shettehe niret shelema, mimmah sheyyannichenna debuqa bah ap al pi shenniret yoter gedola, shehare shelema qetanna qodemet libraka mipperusa gedola. Mikkol maqom, al yibtza mimmenna bammaqom shehayeta debuqa bachabertah, sheshsham niret kiprusa, ella yibtza mimmaqom hashshalem shebbah. Umikkol maqom bapperusa mammash en tzarik lizzaher bazeh libtzoa batztzad hashshalem shebbah, shehare mikkol maqom perusa hi mitztzad shekkenegdo, mah sheen ken bigluseqa shennipreda mechabertah, sheshshelema hi ella shenniret kiprusa bammaqom shennidbeqa venipreda:

Hebiu lepanayv leekol shette shelemot o shette perusot, achat gedola veachat qetanna — mebarek al haggedola. Vehu sheshshettehen mimmin echad veshavot binqiyyut, abal im hayeta haqqetanna pat neqiyya vehaggedola pat qibbar — mebarek al hanneqiyya. Abal im shettehen shavot begadlutan ushettehen neqiyyot, raq shezzo lebana yoter mizzo — mebarek al hallebana yoter. Abal im hashsheniyya sheenah lebana kol kak hi gedola mizzo — yesh lehistappeq ezeh mehen qodemet libraka. Vekol zeh bemin echad, abal im echad shel seorim veechad shel kussemin, ap al pi shehakkussemin yapim uneqiyyim misseorim — mebarek al shel seorim, lepi shehasseora meporeshet bez' hamminim, mah sheen ken kussemin sheap shehen min chittim umikkelal z' hamminim hen, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch — lo hizkiram hakkatub beperush kisorim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheshshettehen chabibot alayv beshaveh, abal im shel kussemin chabib alayv yoter — yesh omerim shemmebarek al hechabib, veyesh omerim shemmebarek al min z' shebbappasuq, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"a:

Hebiu lepanayv leekol pat nokri upat shel yisrael — mebarek al shel yisrael apillu eno nizhar mippat nokrim. Veim pat shel nokri pat neqiyya upat shel yisrael pat qibbar — mebarek al ezeh sheyyirtzeh, im shettehen shelemot o perusot veshavot begodlan vehen mimmin echad. Vehu sheeno nizhar mippat nokrim, abal hannizhar mimmenna — lo yibtza mimmenna beshum inyan. Veyesh omerim sheapillu nizhar mimmenna — rashshay libtzoa mimmenna im hi neqiyya vachabiba alayv, sheissur pat shel nokrim hu issur qal, vehittiruhu mishshum chibbub mitzva, sheyyebarek al hechabib alayv, veyesh lesalleq happat shel nokrim min hashshulchan ad leachar birkat "hammotzi". Veim meseb immo oreach sheeno nizhar mippat shel nokrim vehebi immo al hashshulchan pat shel nokri neqiyya, kevan shehaoreach chapetz leekol hayyapeh shel nokrim, vei epshar lo leekol belo beraka, ubirkato muttelet al baal habbayit lehotzio yede chobato mimmennu — huttera gam lebaal habbayit libtzoa aleha mishshum chibbub mitzva. Vekevan shehuttar lo libtzoa — huttar lo lekol seuda zo, sheeno kebod shamayim sheyyebarek aleha veachar kak yiprosh mimmenna. Veap al pi sheen tzarik lebarek al hechashub vechabib ella kesherotzeh leekol mimmenna, ubaal habbayit zeh shennizhar mippat shel nokrim eno rotzeh leekol kelal mimmenna, mikkol maqom, kevan sheim lo haya nizhar mimmenna hayeta chashuba vachabiba lo, ella shehaissur moneo mimmenna, laken im yimtza illa sheyyukal sheyyoklenna behetter, kegon kan sheyyechabbeb bah hammitzva — hittiru lo chakamim, ki kol birkot hannehenin teluya bachabibut, sheal chabibut hanaato hu mebarek umeshabbeach lehaqqadosh baruk hu. Abal im belo issur pat shel nokrim enah chashuba alayv mippat shel yisrael — tzarik lebarek al pat shel yisrael. Veken lehepek, im baal habbayit eno nizhar mippat shel nokrim, veen dato leekol kol hasseuda ella pat shel nokri ki hi neqiyya, ubene beto okelim pat sheeno neqiyya shel yisrael, ap al pi sheshshette hallechem munnachim lepanayv — tzarik libtzoa al shel nokrim hanneqiyya, hoil veen dato leekol ella mimmenna vehi chabiba alayv. Veap al pi shebbene beto yoklu mishshel yisrael — en zeh kelum, hoil vehu habbotzea:

Birkat "hammotzi" en lah shiur, sheapillu eno rotzeh leekol ella perur pachot mikkazzayit — tzarik lebarek "hammotzi". Velo natenu shiur kazzayit ella bebirkat hammazon ushear berakot acharonot, abal lo bibraka rishona, sheasur lehanot mehaolam hazzeh apillu mashshehu belo beraka.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Belechem gamur, shedderek bene adam liqboa seudato alayv, abal mine lechamim sheyyitbaaru lepanenu sheen darkam shel rob bene adam liqboa seudatam alehem — en mebarekim alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon raq "bore mine mezonot" uberaka achat meen shalosh, ella im ken okel shiur sheacherim regilim liqboa seuda lipamim al shiur kazeh, lepi shebbirkat "bore mine mezonot" kolelet gam hallechem shehu mazon, velo qabeu lebarek "hammotzi" al hallechem ella mippene chashibuto, shessoed halleb, vekol lechem sheen qobeim alayv seuda — betela chashibuto, ella im ken yesh bo kede lisod. Veken d' berakot shel birkat hammazon lo qabeu alayv ella mippene chashibuto, shemmin hattora haya day bibraka achat meen g', shehare lo neemar battora ella paam achat: "uberakta et Hashem eloheka al haaretz hattoba asher natan lak", vedareshu mippasuq zeh: lebarek al hammazon veal haaretz veal hammiqdash, veday bibraka achat lekullam, ella shechakamim tiqqenu lebarek al kol echad bipne atzmo. Velo tiqqenu ella belechem shergilim liqboa seuda alayv, abal mine lechamim sheen regilin liqboa alehem, apillu hu akal vesaba mehem, shennitchayyeb lebarek acharehem min hattora — dayyo bibraka achat meen g' shel tora. Ella im ken akal shiur shebbene adam qobeim alayv kesheokelim min lechem zeh bemiqreh, abal im rob bene adam en qobeim alayv, ap al pi shehu qobea alayv — betela dato etzel rob bene adam. Umikkol maqom, im hu qaba seudato alayv veakal immo basar udebarim acherim, kemo shennohagim bisudat lechem gamur, ad shessaba, vegam acherim regilim liqboa alayv im okelim immo shear debarim kemo sheakal hu — mebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon. Veken im hu sabea mimmennu lebaddo vegam acherim regilin lisboa mimmennu keshemmelappetin oto beezeh liptan — mebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon. Umikkan atta lamed sheshshiur qebiut seuda haamur kan eno keshiur seuda haamur beerub, shehu keg' betzim, shehi pechuta shebbisudat aniyyim habberiim veshem seuda aleha, abal enah seudat rob bene adam habberiim (kesheokelin mimmennu lebaddo belo liptan udebarim acherim), (ella keshiur omer laggulgolet leb' seudot). Sheim lo ken, mah hoilu kan leshaer shiur sheacherim qobeim alayv im ezeh liptan, hare gam al yede liptan en shem seuda aleha bepachot mikkeg' betzim pat. Sheim lo ken, lamma hitzriku bishte seudot shel erube techumin kishte seudot pat, im pachot mikken rauy leb' seudot al yede liptan, yehe day bazeh leerube techumin, miqqal vachomer milliptan shel pat mib' seudot shemmeorbin bo, kol shekken happat hanneekelet beb' seudot hallalu. Veim mittechilla haya bedato leekol meat uberak "bore mine mezonot", veachar kak nimlak veakal shiur sherob bene adam qobeim [seuda] alayv — yebarek acharayv birkat hammazon, ap al pi shello berak "hammotzi" lepanayv, kegon shello haya kede qebiut seuda bemah shennishar lepanayv achar shennimlak. Abal im nimlak leekol od keshiur qebiut seuda millebad mah sheakal kebar — tzarik littol yadayv ulebarek "hammotzi" techilla. Veen tzarik lebarek techilla beraka achat meen g' al mah shekkebar akal, lepi shemmitztarep im mah sheyyokal lehippater bebirkat hammazon, kevan sheshshenehem min lechem echad, mah sheen ken beokel dabar shettaun beraka meen g' lipne seudat lechem gamur, sheen mitztorpin zeh im zeh lehippater bebirkat hammazon, ella tzarik lebarek techilla beraka achat meen g', kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch:

Veellu hem mine lechamim sheen darkam shel bene adam liqboa seudatam alehem: pat habbaa bekisanin, velachmaniyyot, uteroqanin, uterita. Pat habbaa bekisanin — yesh meporshim shehi pat asuya kemin kis, shemmemallein otah qodem apiyyatah bidbash o betzavaq"r o sheqedim o egozim o shear kol mine perot o tablin, ap al pi shehaissa atzmah nillosha bemayim lebad, veneepet betannur o bemachabat belo shum mashqeh (kegon apy"l plady"n o pavvy"dla plady"n). Ubiklal zeh mah sheosim bepurim issa rechaba ukepula umemalleim otah beshumshemin. Vaapillu im hammilluy hu rab meod, veiqqar hakkavvana bepat zo laakilat hammilluy, mikkol maqom, min dagan hu chashub veeno batel legabbe hammilluy veap al pi shehu rab mimmennu, ulekak mebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot", vegam hammilluy niptar bibraka zo, shehu tapel lemin dagan. Vehu shemmitkavvenin gam ken laakilat min haddagan shehi haissa shebbah hammilluy, ap al pi sheen zo iqqar hakkavvana, abal im en mitkavvenin kelal leekol haissa, kegon otam reqiqin daqqin shennotenim mirqachat alehem, shehaddabar yadua sheen mitkavvenim kelal leekol haissa, raq shebbaim ledabbeq hammirqachat alehem kede shello yittanepu hayyadayim mehaddebash — hare hem tepelim legabbe hammirqachat ubirkat hammirqachat potartan. Vaapillu im akal techilla hammirqachat venisharu hareqiqim lebaddam. Abal bimdinot ellu shemmannichim hammirqachat al haddubshanin (sheqqorin laqv"k plady"n) shettobim lemaakal, im ken kavvanato gam ken al akilat haddubshanin, umebarek alehem "bore mine mezonot", upoter et hammirqachat shehi tepela lemin dagan:

Vekol issa shehammilluy tapel eleha, ap al pi sheokelah lebaddah achar shennatal hammilluy mimmenna — eno mebarek aleha ella "bore mine mezonot" velo "hammotzi", hoil ubishat apiyyatah hayeta baa bekisanin. Abal im eno okel ella hammilluy shennatal mimmenna lebaddo — mebarek alayv beraka hareuya lo: "shehakkol", o "bore peri haadama", o "bore peri haetz". Vekol zeh keshehammilluy hu mipperot vekayyotze bahem, middebarim sheen derek liqboa seuda alehem, lo lelappet bahem et happat, velo lemazon ulesoba, ella okelim otam leqinnuach seuda uletaanug, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"z, velaken en darkam shel rob bene adam liqboa seuda gam ken al happat hamemullet mehem. Abal im hammilluy hu middebarim shedderek bene adam liqboa seuda alehem lelappet bahem et happat, kegon basar vedagim ugebina ubetzim viraqot (o shedderek liqboa seuda alehem lemazon ulesoba, ap al pi sheen melappetin bahem happat, kegon kerub uteradin vekol kayyotze bahem mimmaaseh qedera shehem meiqqar hasseuda) kemo sheyyitbaer sham — en milluy zeh motzi et happat hamemullet bo mittorat lechem gamur shehakkol qobeim alayv, lepi sheggam al zo en rob bene adam nimnaim milliqboa seuda alehem mippene hammilluy shebbah, kevan shehammilluy rauy gam ken liqboa alayv seuda lelappet bo et happat (o lemazon ulesoba). Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq ben milluy perot lemilluy basar ugebina vekayyotze bahem, uleolam mebarek "bore mine mezonot", ella im ken okel shiur sherob bene adam qobeim alayv. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Vire shamayim lo yokal mehem pachot mishshiur qebiat seuda ella betok hasseuda lemazon ulesoba, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Veyesh meporshim sheppat habbaa bekisanin hi pat shennillosha bidbash o bechalab vechema o beshumman o beshemen o beme betzim o beme perot veyayin o bishar mashqin, chutz mimmayim. Vaapillu erab bah meat mayim, im harob hu mishshear mashqin — mebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot" uberaka achat meen g'. Veap al pi shekkol hammashqin en motziin haissa shennillosha bahem mittorat lechem leinyan challa, mikkol maqom, en derek bene adam liqboa seuda ella al pat shennillosha bemayim, lepikak en bah chashibut lechem gamur lebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, ella im ken okel shiur sherob bene adam qobeim alayv. Veken im erab bah tablin harbeh yoter mimmayim, ap al pi shennillosha bemayim lebad. Vaapillu im erab bah tablin udebash yoter miqqemach, shekkimat haddebash vehattablin hem iqqar, vehaqqemach hu ledabbeqam ulehaqpotam — en haqqemach tapel etzlam lebarek alehem beraka hareuya lahem, lepi shemmillebad mah shehaqqemach medabbeq umaqpeh hattaarobet, hu makshiro umetaqqeno gam ken laakila, umin hassetam nittan haqqemach betaarobet zeh al daat shenehem, ledabbeq ulehakshir, vekevan shehu min dagan hu chashub veeno batel battaarobet, kol shebba gam ken lehakshiro laakila, velaken mebarekin al taarobet zo "bore mine mezonot". Veim akal shiur qebiut seuda — mebarek birkat hammazon al taarobet zeh (kemo shemmebarekin birkat hammazon al taarobet qemach tebua beqemach qitniyyot sheasa mehem pat, im yesh battaarobet kazzayit bikde akilat peras qemach tebua, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman). Abal issa shennillosha bemayim veerab bah meat debash vetablin, ap al pi shettaam haddebash vetablin nirgash baissa — en mebarekin aleha "bore mine mezonot", ella "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, kevan sheharob mayim. Veken bimat chalab vechema veshemen veshumman ushear mashqin ume perot. Veal ken yapeh osim sheopin ugot (sheqqorin shmal"tz qvk"n) lelechem mishneh, ki en sham raq meat shumman:

Veyesh meporshim sheppat habba bekisanin hi pat shennillosha apillu bemayim, vaapillu enah metubbelet veenah memullet, ella sheosim otah ugot yebeshot, vekosesin otah leteabon velo kede lehasbia (sheqqorin qykly"k). Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehaqel bedibre soperim kedibre kullam, ubiprat bispeq berakot, shello lebarek birkat hammazon d' berakot al mah shellisbara achat day bibraka achat meen g', ki en kan sapeq shel tora ap im akal kede sebia shehu chayyab bebirkat hammazon min hattora, shehare min hattora day leolam bibraka achat meen g'. Vekevan shemmebarek beraka achat meen g' — en lo lebarek "hammotzi", shello yihyu birkotayv soterot zo et zo. Veod, shebbirkat "bore mine mezonot" kolelet gam ken lechem gamur, ella shemmippene chashibuto hotziuhu mikkelal shear mazon veqabeu lo beraka bipne atzmo, vekol sheen barur lanu sheyyesh bo chashibut lechem gamur — en lehotzio mechezqato shehu biklal mazon bevadday. Veap al pi shehambarek "bore mine mezonot" al lechem gamur — lo yatza yede chobato, hoil venishtanna leilluy vachashibut nishtannet birkato, mikkol maqom, bispeq lechem gamur — yatza, shessepeq berakot shel dibrehem lehaqel. Vaapillu lekattechilla en kan chashash beraka lebattala, shekkevan sheheqelu chakamim bedibrehem latzet bispeq beraka — en zo beraka sheenah tzerika, veenah lebattala bevadday, kevan sheyyotze bah yede chobato, verashshay leekol al yadah, veeno nose shem shamayim lashshov velo lashsheqer, shehare mebarek Hashem beemet, shebbara mine mezonot, velo od ella sheggam zeh mazon hu. Ella shekkesheeno yotze bah yede chobato bibraka zo — hare zo beraka sheenah tzerika, venose shem shamayim lashshov, abal lo lashsheqer, apillu im berak al dabar sheeno mazon kelal. Vekol baal nepesh harotzeh lehachamir al atzmo — lo yokal pachot mishshiur qebiut seuda (ella pat shennillosha bemashqin o me perot vehi memullet beperot vekayyotze bahem) ki im betok hasseuda lemazon ulesoba, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Lachmaniyyot hen reqiqin daqqim (sheqqorin nybl"sh), ubiqtzat medinot ellu (blyna"sh), hannaasim mittaarobet qemach umayim biqdera belila rakka meod, veshopekim al ale yeraqot rechabim veneepet betannur im healim, o shopekim al machabat sheen bah mashqeh sheddinah ketannur, ben shehirtichah techilla veachar kak shapak bah, ben sheshshapak bah veachar kak hirtichah. Umeat mashqeh shemmoshechin hammachabat shello tissarep haissa — eno niqra mashqeh. Abal im yesh bah mashqeh, apillu okel mehem shiur qebiat seuda — mebarek "bore mine mezonot" umeen g', lepi shello hayeta alehem torat lechem meolam, lo bishat lishatam kevan shebbelilatam rakka, velo bishat apiyyatam kevan shennitgenu bemashqeh, veen lechem ella haapuy velo metuggan. Vaapillu otam sheen belilatan rakka meod, kol sheen belilatan aba — en alehen torat lechem bishat lisha, velo bishat apiyya im nitgenu bemashqeh. Abal im neepu betannur o bemachabat beli mashqeh — lechem gamur hu, umebarekin alayv "hammotzi" apillu lo akal shiur qebiat seuda, shekkevan sheen belilatan rakka meod — darkam shel bene adam liqboa alehem seuda lipamim, ap al pi sheen belilatam aba legamre. Veyesh omerim sheotan shebbelilatan rakka meod en mebarekin alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon kesheokel shiur qebiut seuda ella kesheenan reqiqin daqqin meod achar haapiyya, kegon sheshshapak harbeh al healim o al hammachabat ad shennaasu abim qetzat al yede haapiyya, ap al pi sheenan abim legamre, abal im gam achar haapiyya hem reqiqim daqqim meod, kegon otam sheopim bidpus ben b' barzillim — en qebiut seuda moelet bahem lebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, lepi sheen alehem torat lechem kelal gam bishat haapiyya, kevan shehem reqiqim daqqim meod. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem, shello leekol mehem keshiur qebiut seuda ki im betok hasseuda lemazon ulesoba. Veken bitrita, dehaynu shelloqechim qemach umayim umeorbin veshopekin al hakkira vehu mitpashshet veneepa — yesh omerim sheen alayv torat lechem kelal, vaapillu okel keshiur qebiut seuda — mebarek "bore mine mezonot" umeen g'. (Abal teroqanin dehaynu sheosim gumma bakkira venotenim bah qemach umayim meorabim bah, ap al pi shebbelilatah rakka meod, mikkol maqom kevan sheal yede haapiyya naasim abim — moelet bahem qebiut seuda lebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon keal lechem gamur. Abal bepachot mishshiur qebiut seuda mebarek "bore mine mezonot", hoil ubelilato rakka meod, veen derek rob bene adam liqboa alehem seuda):

Vekol mine lechamim hallalu sheen derek rob bene adam liqboa seuda alehem, im ba leoklam betok hasseuda leqinnuach seuda uletaanug, lehaqel mikkobed hammaakal, kemo shergilin shekkosesin ugot yebeshot besop hasseuda o mine metiqa — enam niptarim bebirkat happat, vetzarik lebarek alehem battechilla "bore mine mezonot", kemo shetztzarik lebarek al perot sheokelin beqinnuach seuda, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"z. Ella shehappat habbaa bekisanin, lepi shennechlequ bah, veyesh omerim shellechem gamur hu mah sheyyesh omerim shehu pat habbaa bekisanin, lepikak en lebarek betok hasseuda ella al mah shelledibre hakkol niqra pat habbaa bekisanin. Abal im ba leoklam lemazon ulesoba — hare hem baim mechamat hasseuda veniptarim bebirkat happat, kemo shenniptarim kol maaseh qedera shebbetok hasseuda shebbaim lemazon ap al pi sheen melappetin bahem et happat, kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Vaapillu mine issa hamemullaim beperot — en tzarik lebarek apillu al happerot shebbahem kemo shemmebarekin al shear happerot shebbetok hasseuda, lepi shehapperot hallalu hem tepelim legabbe haissa shehi mine dagan, veniptarim immah bebirkat happat, hoil vehi baa betok hasseuda lemazon ulesoba, kemo shehem niptarim immah bebirkat "bore mine mezonot", keshemmebarek aleha shello betok hasseuda, o betok hasseuda keshehi baa leqinnuach vetaanug. Veen lehachamir veliqqach qetzat perot min haissa ulebarek alehem, ki hi beraka lebattala im okel gam haissa. Vaapillu mine issa shebbelilatam rakka meod venitgenu bemashqeh, sheen alehem torat lechem kelal apillu kesheokelim mehem shiur qebiut seuda, ap al pi ken niptarim bebirkat happat keshebbaim betok hasseuda lemazon ulesoba, kemo shenniptarim kol maaseh qedera shebbaim letabshil ulemazon:

Abal kol dabar shebbelilatah aba legamre, sheyyesh alayv torat lechem bishat lisha — yesh omerim sheapillu rikkeko bemayim vaasao supganin ubishshelo bemayim o tiggeno bemashqeh — lo nitbattela torat lechem mimmennu leinyan "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, kemo shello nitbattela mimmennu leinyan challa. Veim okelo betok hasseuda — niptar bebirkat happat kemo shear lechem gamur, vaapillu okelo leqinnuach uletaanug bilbad. Veyesh omerim shennitbattel mimmennu torat lechem al yede bishshul o tiggun, vaapillu okel mimmennu shiur qebiut seuda — eno mebarek ella "bore mine mezonot" umeen g', vaapillu im hu beinyan sheqqaruy lechem leinyan challa, kegon shebbishat lisha lo haya bedato lebashshelo o letaggeno veachar kak nimlak, shehu chayyab bechalla, lepi shebbechalla hakkol holek achar gilgul haqqemach bammayim, sheaz chal chiyyub challa, ulepikak keshehayeta alayv torat lechem bishat lisha shehayeta belilatah aba — miyyad chal alayv chiyyub challa, veshub lo nipqa mimmennu al yede bishshul vetiggun, abal leinyan "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon hakkol holek achar haapiyya, keshennaasa rauy laakila, vekol shello neepa betannur o bemachabat beli mashqeh — eno qaruy lechem. Veim akalo betok hasseuda leqinnuach uletaanug — eno niptar bebirkat happat. Vire shamayim yotze yede shenehem, velo yoklennu ella betok hasseuda lemazon ulesoba. Abal hamminhag lehaqel kisbara acharona (ki ken iqqar):

Veap lassebara harishona yesh omerim sheen tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon ella kesheokel shiur qebiut seuda, sheim lo ken day bebirkat "bore mine mezonot" umeen g' kemo lepat habbaa bekisanin, shehu gam ken lechem gamur lechalla, veap al pi ken, kevan sheen darkam shel bene adam liqboa aleha en mebarekin aleha "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, ap al mine tiggun gam ken en derek liqboa seuda alehem (ulepi dibrehem, ap lassebara harishona tzarik lebarek alehem "bore mine mezonot" betok hasseuda im okel mehem meat leqinnuach uletaanug). Veyesh choleqim (veomerim sheenam domin) lepat habbaa bekisanin, shehi gam ken lechem gamur ledibre haomerim shehi pat shennillosha bemashqin o me perot, abal mine tiggun shebbishat lishatam hayu lechem gamur — lo nipqa mehem shem lechem gamur al yede tiggun o bishshul leinyan "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, kemo shello nipqa mehem leinyan challa lassebara harishona. Abal ledibre haomerim sheppat habbaa bekisanin hi pat gemura shennillosha bemayim lebad, ella sheachar kak mille otah debash o bemine perot, o asa mimmenna ugot daqqot yebeshot, vekosesin oto leteabon, veap shebbishat lisha haya lechem gamur, vegam neepu betannur kelechem gamur — ap al pi ken en mebarekin alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, hoil veen derek rob bene adam liqboa alehem, kol shekken issa shennillosha bemayim veachar kak bishshelah o tiggenah bemashqeh o bidbash, shebbevadday hattiggun bidbash eno garua mimmilluy bidbash haapuy betannur shemmebattelo mittorat lechem gamur, shehare hammilluy eno ella bipnim, ubetiggun kol haissa hi sheruya bidbash ubelua mimmennu bekullah, vegam lo neepet betannur kelal. Ukebar nitbaer lemala shemmin haddin yesh lehaqel bedibre soperim, vekol shekken kan shehamminhag lehaqel bekol inyan:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh toar lechem al haissa achar hattiggun vehabbishshul, kegon shenneepet bemachabat, ella shehaya sham meat mayim shennitbashshela bahem bishat apiyyatah, o meat mashqeh shennitgena bahem bishat apiyyatah, kemo pashtida"a vplady"n vqraply"k. Ella shehappashtida vplady"n shehen memullaot bebasar ugebina — yesh omerim shehen pat habbaa bekisanin apillu im neepu betannur, veen mebarekim alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon belo qebiut seuda ledibre hakkol. Veim okelan betok hasseuda — niptarot bebirkat happat apillu hen metugganot, mippene shehen bain letabshil ulemazon velo leqinnuach vetaanug, kevan shehen memullaim bebasar ugebina velo beperot. Abal mine issa shennitbashshelu biqdera (kemo vrymzly"k bilshon ashkenaz, sheqqorin beartzenu laqshy"n, veken qraply"k bimqomot sheen opim otan kelal bemachabat sheyyesh bah mashqeh, ella mebashshelim otan techilla veachar kak metaggenin otan) — en alehem toar lechem kelal, veen lehachamir bahem kelal shello leoklam belo "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon apillu biqbiut seuda, vaapillu hen chatikot gedolot, sheyyesh bekol achat kazzayit veyoter:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beissa shennitbashshela, abal lechem gamur shennitbashshel — lo nitbattel mittorat lechem al yede bishshul apillu lassebara haacharona, vaapillu al yede tiggun, umebarekim aleha "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon apillu belo qebiut seuda, vaapillu im nimmoach babbishshul velo nishar mikkol perusa ella kazzayit. Abal perusa pechuta mikkezayit, ben shehayeta perusa gedola venechleqa babbishshul, ben shehayeta pechuta mikkezayit qodem shennitbashshela — yotza mittorat lechem al yede bishshul leinyan beraka, apillu im nireh sheyyesh bah toar lechem, shekkevan shennitbashshel — eno chashub toar lechem, umebarek "bore mine mezonot" umeen g', apillu im okel shiur qebiut seuda mipperurim pechutim mikkezayit. Vaapillu nidbequ al yede habbishshul veyesh bahem atta kezayit veyoter bekol chatika, ella sheqqodem habbishshul lo haya bekol echad bipne atzmo kezayit. Vehu shennitbashshelu bikli rishon, abal im hinnicham biqara veera alehem mikkeli rishon — taluy bemachaloqet shennechlequ beeruy im mebashshel kikli rishon im lav. Laken yesh limnoa shello leoklam ki im betok hasseuda im nireh sheyyesh alehem toar lechem, dehaynu shennikkar veyadua shehu lechem. Abal im halak mehem toar hallechem al yede haeruy, vaapillu perurim hashsheruyim bemayim tzonenim shehalak mehem toar hallechem al yede sheriyya zo — mebarek alehem "bore mine mezonot" umeen g', apillu im okel shiur qebiut seuda, shekkebar nitbattelu veyatzeu mittorat lechem legamre, kevan sheen kezayit bekol echad vegam lo toar lechem. Vekol shehammayim mitlabbenim mechamat happerurim — kebar halak mehem toar hallechem. Vehu haddin lachatikot pat shemmeyabbeshin al haggechalim veshorin oto beshekar, sheim en kezayit bekol echad veen toar lechem — mebarekin alehem "bore mine mezonot":

Veken perure lechem shemmechabberim umedabbeqim otam biqara bidbash o chalab o maraq, im en alehem toar lechem mechamat zeh, veen bekol echad bipne atzmo kezayit — en mebarekim alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon apillu biqbiut seuda, kemo bebishshul vetiggun lassebara haacharona shennitbaer lemala shekken iqqar. Abal perure lechem sheenan mechubbarin yachad, ap al pi sheen alehem toar lechem mippene shehen daqqin beyoter — mebarekin alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon apillu belo qebiut seuda, apillu al perur echad daq keqemach mebarek "hammotzi", shekkevan shehu pat bipne atzmo beli taarobet shum mashqeh betoko hamchabbero umedabbeqo — eno yotze mittorat pat leolam. Vaapillu im noten perurim daqqim letok ezeh mashqeh lepi shaa lerakkekam, veenam shohim betoko ad sheyyelek toar hallechem mealehem al yede sheriyya zo — mebarek alehem "hammotzi", ap al pi sheen alehem toar lechem mechamat shehem daqqim beyoter. Vaapillu im notenam bemashqeh cham shehayyad soledet bahem, im hu bikli sheni sheeno mebashshel:

Veken im perer hallechem leperurim daqqim keqemach vechazar vegibbelam yachad, apillu nishru techilla bemayim ad shehalak toar hallechem mehem, kevan sheakshav yesh bahem kezayit — tzarik lebarek alayv "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, shebbekazzayit en tzarik toar lechem. Vaapillu lash otam berotechin shel keli sheni, vaapillu im lash otam bemashqin ume perot — en lahem din pat habbaa bekisanin, shekkevan shehayu lechem gamur mittechillatam — enan yotzeim leolam mittorat pat, ella im ken en bekol echad kazzayit (veenan megubbalim yachad bederek lisha, ella mechubbarim bilbad al yede ezeh mashqeh hamdabbeqam zeh im zeh, o shennishru betoko ad shehalak mehem toar hallechem[)]. Vaapillu im achar hallisha tiggenan bemashqeh, o apillu bishshelam biqdera — lo nitbattelu mittorat lechem, kemo shebbikzayit lechem gamur lo nitbattel mittorat lechem al yede tiggun ubishshul. Umikkol maqom, im erab bahem qemach vetiggenan beshemen o shear mashqim — yesh lehistappeq im nelek achar harob (shehu haqqemach vehashshumman), veen mebarekim alehem "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon apillu biqbiut seuda). Veken im lash otam im shumman veqemach harbeh mehem, im nelek achar haqqemach velo yebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon ella beshiur qebiut seuda achar haapiyya, kedin qemach shennillosh beshumman o bemashqin ume perot veneepa betannur. Ki epshar shekkemo shemmin dagan chashub veeno batel berob bishar minim, kak lechem gamur eno batel berob mippene chashibuto apillu beqemach shel min dagan. Abal im lash otam berotechin mikkeli rishon, kevan sheyyatzeu mittorat lechem beshaa shennitbashshelu berotechin velo haya bahem kezayit bekol perur, hare dinam keqemach shennillosh shemmebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot" achar hattiggun ap al pi sheyyesh bo kezayit:

Yesh mi sheomer shehashshoreh pitto beyayin adom, hoil venishtannet tzuratah al yede zeh — batel mimmenna toar lechem, veim en bekol perusa kezayit — mebarek "bore mine mezonot" umeen g' apillu okel shiur qebiut seuda. Vegam en tzarik lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al hayyayin habbalua bappat, mippene shehu tapel eleha. Veken hashshoreh pat shemmebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot" beyen sarap o bishar mashqin — en tzarik lebarek al hammashqin habbeluim bah. Abal im berak al happat "hammotzi" — en tzarik lebarek kelal al shear mashqin apillu bederek shetiyya, sheen mebarekin al shetiyya shebbetok hasseuda, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"b. Veken keshennotenim yayin baqqeara im hammelach litbol bo habbasar — en tzarik lebarek al hayyayin mippene shehu tapel labbasar, vehabbasar kebar niptar bebirkat "hammotzi", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"z:

Qemach shechalato berotechin veachar kak asa mimmennu pat vaapaah betannur o bemachabat belo mashqeh — lechem gamur hu, umebarekim alayv "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon. Vaapillu hayeta belilato rakka bemayim rotechin, kevan sheachar kak apao belo mashqeh — naasa lechem gamur (ella im ken hayeta belilato rakka meod, sheaz apillu belo chalita berotechin en mebarekin aleha "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon ella keshiur qebiut seuda, kemo shennitbaer lemala):

Batzeq sheopin beshappud umoshechin oto tamid beshemen o shumman o me betzim o me perot — en torat lechem alayv kelal, umebarek alayv "bore mine mezonot" umeen g' (apillu biqbiut seuda). Abal lechem gamur shetztzolin beshappud, ap shemmoshechin oto beshemen — eno yotze mittorat lechem leolam, kemo shennitbaer lemala: (makan ad siman qa"d la namatza gam badapos harashon)
